notes: Identity independently checked: supplied text matches title A Cross-Cultural Investigation of Metamotivational Beliefs About Regulatory Focus Task-Motivation Fit; authors Tina Nguyen, Taku Togawa, Abigail A. Scholer, David B. Miele, and Kentaro Fujita; DOI 10.1177/01461672211025423. Primary research article, PSPB 2022, 48(5), 807–820, accepted/copyright 2021, consistent with reference. Text extends through references. No source PDF supplied; no acquisition or rendering performed. Target matched by experiment, outcome, named factors and contrast. Original descriptions do not restrict culture or context; overall model effects are extracted rather than American-independent subgroup effects. All targets report Bayesian estimates, SEs and HDIs. Parallel frequentist analyses are directed to the SOM, which is not supplied; no p inferred from HDIs. Continuous variables were standardized within culture; categorical factors were effect coded. Printed βest is retained without conversion or assuming a fully standardized beta. Unassigned n, replication and reported_success are placeholders.
